name: DSI Prophet '08
description: Dave Smith Instruments Prophet '08, layers A and B, every voice and global parameter in its manual's NRPN tables.

sources.title: Prophet '08 Manual (version 1.3)
sources.notes: NRPN tables read by tools/profiles/sequential/read-nrpn-tables.mjs from Prophet_08_Manual_v1.3.pdf, pages 49-50-51-57 (sha256 4885effed49b9fa54b4d5bfa809e3f3f61e19b479fdb71e1b3e62a7a12617ad6), https://sequential.com/downloads/prophet_keyboard/doc/Prophet_08_Manual_v1.3.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
Left out, the program name, one character per NRPN; CEditor cannot edit text over NRPN yet: NRPN 184-199.
Left out, printed without a range: NRPN 102-117 (x Unused).

coverage.editBufferDumpRequest: notImplemented: the manual's program dump is not mapped yet
coverage.inboundControllers: the front panel sends these same NRPNs when the Global MIDI parameter send is set to NRPN
